Messages.Author: Jon cooper
Messages.Body:
Have been giving the Baali a moments thought recently and come up with
this.

Crypt:
12x Baali - 3xMary, 3xGiotto,3xHigh Priest Angry Mooey,
3xHuitzphotclithingy.

Library: 86 cards
10xPier13
20x Leather jacket
15xRave
15xBums Rush
1xPsychomania
14xDisarm
1xWake

Get the pier13 on one of them, give them a leather at the end of your
turn. Next turn Rave it onto someone else. They rush, prevent and
disarm.
Give another leather to pier13 dude again. Etc etc etc.
Also gets around ppaying for the devil worshippers as well. Nice.
Could be trimmed down to 70 cards to improve the flow, but quite
frankly i wouldnt know what to take out.

Messages.Author: RonnieE
Messages.Body:
Greatings Jon.
First of, if I don´t remember wrong your crypt can´t include more than
75% of a certain clan. Look it up, it could be the other way around.

jon.c...@damovo.com (Jon cooper) wrote in message news:<73e3f8cc.0211...@posting.google.com>...

> Have been giving the Baali a moments thought recently and come up with
> this.
>
> Crypt:
> 12x Baali - 3xMary, 3xGiotto,3xHigh Priest Angry Mooey,
> 3xHuitzphotclithingy.

These are all high cap, and tp prevent ending up with coppies in your
uncontrolled region, you need some to fill it out.
Try the Setites with Potence, such as Danny Larkshill.Or the Setite
arkon Samat, to finish of the ones you rush. You´ll need a good Blood
Doll, so add Hesha. Could try Basil or Smudge for cannibals, they
won´t be missed if they burn.

>
> Library: 86 cards
> 10xPier13
> 20x Leather jacket
> 15xRave
> 15xBums Rush
> 1xPsychomania
> 14xDisarm
> 1xWake
>
> Get the pier13 on one of them, give them a leather at the end of your
> turn.

You do know that Pier 13 doesn´t count as an equip action, so the
minion won´t untap?

Next turn Rave it onto someone else.

Wich won´t untap them eather, check card text:
"Name: Rave
[SW]
Cardtype: Action
+1 stealth action.
Move as much blood (or life) and/or equipment from the acting minion
to any ready vampires you control."
Your moving, not equiping.

They rush, prevent and
> disarm.

You´ll need more Potence to do this.
Try:
6 Torn Signpost
8 Immortal Grapple
4 Conflagration (For the decks that manuever with guns)
7 Disarm

> Give another leather to pier13 dude again. Etc etc etc.

See above.

> Also gets around ppaying for the devil worshippers as well.

No

Nice.

No, a dream :-)

> Could be trimmed down to 70 cards to improve the flow, but quite
> frankly i wouldnt know what to take out.

It´s more a start over kind of thing.

So let´s see:

To untap you don´t use Leather Jackets, you could try:
5 Concordance.

This means that you´ll untap in the end of your phase and you´ll block
instead of rush, so you´ll need intercept. Try:
2 Sportbikes
1 Mr Winthrop
1 KRCG News Radio
1 Club Zombie
8 Corruption
10 Sense the Sin

The idea being, corrupt with the Setites, Sense them with the Baali,
smash them and let someone eat them.

You´ll need masters to fill them with blood. So:
1 The Rack
1 The Coven
1 Temple Hunting Ground
1 Giants Blood
4 Blood Dolls
1 Hunt Club (For Samat, people realy hate that)
1 Opium Den (For the Corruptions mainly)

And when they are Blood Dolls start going forward with:
10 Forgery.

Let the Baali pay there own untap as Blood Dolls, and fill them up
with bleeding actions.

To get all this through, you´ll need
5 Forgotten Labyrinth
5 Lost in Crowds
1 Creepshow Cassino

Your next problem will be Voting decks. Try:
6 Dread Gaze.

When you get them in your hand, leave one or more untapped, even after
blocking your corrupted prey, and lay down the law :-) Won´t stop IC
but it will slow down the weenie voters.

Good luck

Ronnie
Hailing Shaitan in a Foxhole
